tbesh_html:
§ Padan or Padan-aram = "field"
a plain or tableland in northern Mesopotamia in Aram, a region of Syria

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or פַּדַּן אֲרָם; from the same and H758 (אֲרָם); the table-land of Aram;
